title: Metamorphic Relations for Reward Model Consistency

original_idea.body:
# Metamorphic Relations for Reward Model Consistency

**Problem:** Reward models have no ground-truth oracle; metamorphic testing solves the no-oracle problem.

**Direction:** Define metamorphic relations on an open RM and measure violation rates per relation. Inference only.

**Why it matters:** A cheap training-free signal of RM misspecification; a regression-style test suite.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2312.06056; arXiv:2511.02108; arXiv:2406.06864.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Training-free diagnostic for RM misspecification, a core alignment failure; clear chain to a reusable test suite.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inference-only metamorphic perturbations on an open RM; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: defined relations, violation rates, clear metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open RMs, no proprietary data; independent-friendly safety tooling.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference only on a few hundred pairs.

novelty.reasoning: Metamorphic LLM testing exists; RM-specific relations may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Metamorphic LLM testing exists; RM-specific relations may be open.
